description: User supplied X threads and UI/UX screenshots normalized for AIO Screener page and AI-context integration. These are design/framework references, not live market data.

items.title: Labor-inflation prism: do not rely on a single unemployment/inflation aggregate

extraction.thesis: Analyze layoff unemployment, quits, duration, common inflation, wage pressure, and expectations together.
extraction.automationHint: Refresh with official labor/inflation releases and classify as SNAPSHOT only after data cross-check.

items.title: High-growth theme rotation and FOMO entry risk

extraction.thesis: A good business can be a bad entry when institutional distribution, washout risk, and macro duration sensitivity are ignored.
extraction.automationHint: Use screener factor rotation and price/volume confirmation before raising conviction.

items.title: Chart patterns are risk/reward tools, not predictions

extraction.thesis: Patterns mostly do not predict; they define asymmetric reward/risk and invalidation.
extraction.automationHint: Render entry, invalidation, and reward/risk before pattern names.

items.title: Small and mid-cap growth buy filter

extraction.thesis: Check bottleneck, vertical integration, backlog visibility, production reality, kill condition, and dilution use.
extraction.automationHint: Map to 17-perspective company analysis and missing-data warnings.

items.title: Candles, moving averages, MACD, patience, and timing

extraction.thesis: Chart analysis should read psychology and timing through candles, moving averages, MACD, and patience.
extraction.automationHint: Favor plan blocks: entry zone, invalidation, stop, holding period, confidence.

extraction.thesis: Separate shortages from bottlenecks across GPU, HBM, CPU, storage, optics, neocloud, and power.
extraction.automationHint: Use value-chain layer tags to diversify recommendations beyond one market or one company.

items.title: Premium screener UX references: heatmap, factor table, grouped comparison, chart cockpit, sector detail

extraction.thesis: Use clean board layout, compact metrics, heatmap rows, grouped tables, chart-first cockpit, and strong numeric hierarchy.
extraction.automationHint: UI patterns apply immediately because they are not market facts.

items.title: Visual report references: Minervini overlay, macro one-pager, Korea daily card, DART financial dashboard

extraction.thesis: AI chat can generate structured visual report cards in-browser and export them as PNG when current page data exists.
risks: image looks authoritative while data is stale
extraction.automationHint: Every generated visual must show sourceKind and asOf.
